answer_1.quote: We focus on safety and context length vulnerabilities, not on standard NLG tasks such as summarization or translation.

answer_2.quote: We use ASR as our evaluation metric... We also compare NLL, but ASR directly measures the harmfulness of generated responses.

answer_3.quote: We evaluated several judge models including the Llama Guard... and also explored using LLMs as judges including GPT-4o, Claude 3.5 Sonnet and Gemini 1.5 Pro. Quantitative analysis indicated GPT-4o as the most reliable judge model.
